page.layout: One block of text, centred verse and signature, with a woodcut ornament below; faint show-through from the reverse page in the right margin (not transcribed).

main_text.p:
Et timidum recreare blando
Sermone vatem : Tutior hinc tuo
Fauore Flacci dulciloquas sequor
Artes Venusini, & canoros
Æoliæ modulos Camænæ.
Hinc dente siquis me petat inuido
Te fretus illum vindice negligam,
Linguas procaces, impotensque
Arbitrium popularis auræ.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a cherub's head between scrolls and fruit swags) below the text; not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is present in the right margin and was ignored. The printed signature "A 3" at the foot is faint and uncertain.
